title: Why is my trimmed clip frozen at the start?
fullTitle: FFmpeg trim Without setpts: 25 Frozen Frames in .mov, a 1 s Gap in .mkv

scenes.narration: You cut a clip with the trim filter, and the start is frozen, or the audio is a second off. Is trim broken? We cut one second out of a four second synthetic clip, with and without set p t s, and measure first frame time, frame count, repeats, and audio start.
captions: Why is the trimmed start frozen?
We measure first frame time, frame count, repeats, audio start.

scenes.chapter: A clip that names its frames
scenes.narration: One hundred frames, and each frame's brightness names its own index. The tone's loudness names its own time. The cut is frames twenty five to forty nine. The control is dash s s one dash t one: twenty five frames, the first at zero, forty eight thousand samples. Trim with set p t s matches it exactly. Readers: frame md5, raw luma and samples in Node, f f probe.
captions: Control: 25 frames, first at 0.00 s, 48000 samples.
trim + setpts equals the control, frame for frame.

scenes.chapter: Without setpts, in a mov file
scenes.narration: Now trim alone, written to a dot mov file. Fifty frames, not twenty five. Twenty five of them are repeats of frame twenty five: a frozen start. Frame md5 and raw luma agree, and the clip now ends at two seconds, not one.
captions: mov: 50 frames, 25 repeats, ends at 2.00 s.
Frame md5 and raw luma agree: 25 repeats.

scenes.narration: The same command written to a dot m k v file gives twenty five frames, zero repeats, and the control's hashes. But the first frame sits at one second. Pixels cannot see that gap; only timestamps can. The cause is the default frame rate mode. Dash f p s underscore mode c f r fills the gap in both files. Passthrough leaves it in both.
captions: mkv: 25 frames, 0 repeats, first frame at 1.00 s.
fps_mode cfr: 50 frames in both. passthrough: 25.

scenes.narration: Audio keeps its source stamps too: it starts at one second in both files, samples identical to the control. So with no set p t s anywhere, picture and sound stay in sync, one second late. Stamp only the video, and the audio is one second late. Stamp only the audio, and it is one second early.
captions: Neither stamped: in sync, 1.00 s late.
Video only: audio +1.00 s. Audio only: -1.00 s.

scenes.narration: Stamp both streams from zero, or cut with dash s s and dash t. Check the first frame time with f f probe, not by eye. Not tested: players, black frames, other containers, real footage, other builds.
captions: Stamp both from zero, or use -ss and -t.
Not tested: players, black frames, real footage, other builds.
